Man Shot at Trump Rally in 2024 Dies from Injuries

James Copenhaver, aged 76, has died in Pittsburgh from complications stemming from injuries sustained during an assassination attempt on then-candidate Donald Trump at a rally in Butler, Pennsylvania, in July 2024. Copenhaver was one of three attendees shot during the incident. His death occurred two years after he was wounded.
